def Function.Injective.{u_1, u_2} : {α : Sort u_1} → {β : Sort u_2} → (α → β) → Prop :=
fun {α} {β} f => ∀ ⦃a₁ a₂ : α⦄, f a₁ = f a₂ → a₁ = a₂
